label: Move entry up
summary: Moves the given pattern entry of the smart material brush one place up in the list.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Move this pattern entry Up", active while CanReorderRangeToPrev is true. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Save presets
summary: Saves all presets and patterns of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the save button, active only while HasDoneAnyChangesToPresets is true. It returns nothing.

label: Painting mode itself
summary: A function on the engine's smart material painting tool that, going by its name, hands back the tool itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Set angle
summary: Sets the left or the right angle of a pattern in the smart material brush from the value typed in.
details: The angles give the angular range the pattern's behaviour depends on. Vanilla calls it when typing in the "Angle L:" or "Angle R:" field is finished. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which angle: `yes` for left, `no` for right.

label: Set bleeding
summary: Sets the bleeding of a pattern in the smart material brush from the value typed in.
details: Bleeding is the range, in heightmap pixels, over which the ground shapes are averaged: smaller gives sharp results, bigger blurry ones. Vanilla calls it when typing in the "Bleeding:" field is finished. It returns nothing.

label: Set density
summary: Sets the density of a pattern in the smart material brush from the value typed in.
details: Density is how many rays read the surrounding ground: more is more precise but slower to paint. Vanilla calls it when typing in the "Density:" field is finished. It returns nothing.

label: Choose eraser
summary: Makes the eraser, which erases the painted mask, the chosen tool of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the eraser button. It returns nothing.

label: Choose eye dropper
summary: Makes the eye dropper the chosen tool of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the brush's eye dropper button. It returns nothing.

label: Name pattern entry
summary: Sets the name of a pattern entry in the smart material brush to the text typed in.
details: The name need not be unique (the editor's tooltip). Vanilla calls it when typing in the entry's name field is finished. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Set curve type
summary: Sets a pattern's curve type in the smart material brush to the entry chosen in the dropdown.
details: Vanilla calls it when the choice in the interpolations dropdown, the list of curve types next to the curve icon, changes. It returns nothing.

label: Set mask offset
summary: Sets the X or the Y offset of a pattern entry's opacity mask from the value typed in.
details: The offset goes from 0.0 to 1.0. Vanilla calls it when typing in the "Offset X:" or "Offset Y:" field is finished. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which axis: `yes` for X, `no` for Y.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Set mask rotation
summary: Sets how far a pattern entry's opacity mask is turned, from the value typed in.
details: Vanilla calls it when typing in the "Rotation:" field is finished. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Set mask scale
summary: Sets the X or the Y scale of a pattern entry's opacity mask from the value typed in.
details: Vanilla calls it when typing in the "Scale X:" or "Scale Y:" field is finished. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which axis: `yes` for X, `no` for Y.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Choose painter
summary: Makes the painter, which paints the preview mask, the chosen tool of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the painter button. It returns nothing.

label: Set pattern type
summary: Sets a pattern's type in the smart material brush to the entry chosen in the pattern types dropdown.
details: Vanilla calls it when the choice in the dropdown of pattern types changes, with `yes` as the second argument; the file's own comment says that applies the defaults while changing the type. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: Whether to apply the new type's default settings.

label: Set opacity method
summary: Sets how a pattern entry of the smart material brush works out its opacity from the matching points around.
details: Vanilla has four buttons: 0 "By Average" (all surrounding points in the bleeding range), 1 "By Average Min" (the ray with the fewest matching points), 2 "By Average Max" (the ray with the most), 3 "By Nearest Distance" (the distance to the nearest matching point). It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Choose preset
summary: Makes the preset chosen in the smart material brush's preset dropdown the current one.
details: Vanilla calls it when the choice in the "Preset:" dropdown changes. It returns nothing.

label: Set sharpness
summary: Sets the sharpness of a pattern in the smart material brush from the value typed in.
details: Sharpness is the range in which each point that reads the ground shape averages its angles; smaller gives sharper angles. Vanilla calls it when typing in the "Sharpness:" field is finished. It returns nothing.

label: Add material to mix
summary: Opens the material browser to add a material to a pattern's material mix in the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the "+" button with the tooltip "Add material entry to the mix". It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The pattern that gets the material.

label: Change mix material
summary: Opens the material browser to swap one material of a pattern's material mix for another.
details: Vanilla uses it when clicking a material in the "Material Mix"; the tooltip reads "Click to change", then the material's name, then "material to different one". It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The pattern whose mix is changed.

label: Start material share edit
summary: Starts a change of material shares made with a slider of the smart material brush's material mix.
details: Vanilla calls it when dragging the slider next to a material starts; EndSampleCompositionEdit finishes it. It returns nothing.

label: Toggle autosave
summary: Switches the smart material brush's autosave on or off.
details: With autosave on, all changes to presets and patterns are saved when the map editor closes. Vanilla uses it on the "Autosave" checkbox. It returns nothing.

label: Toggle debugging
summary: Switches visual debugging on or off for the given pattern entry of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Toggle visual debugging of this pattern". It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Toggle entry visibility
summary: Shows or hides the given pattern entry of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Toggle visibility of this pattern". It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Toggle material lock
summary: Locks or unlocks a material, so the smart material brush makes no changes to that layer on the map.
details: Vanilla uses it on the lock button of a material in the "Material Mix". It returns nothing.

label: Lock material share
summary: Locks or unlocks the share of one material in a pattern's material mix, so it keeps its percentage.
details: Vanilla uses it on the padlock next to a material's share; while locked its slider and number field are off. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg2
fields.text: The pattern entry the mix belongs to.
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Toggle topology picker
summary: Switches the smart material brush's terrain topology picker mode on or off.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Toggle terrain topology picker mode". It returns nothing.

label: Access window itself

details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Notifications anchor

details: Vanilla uses it as the layout anchor of the list of chat notifications. Its type is not registered for scripts.

label: Hide window

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the social notification window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Should be shown

label: Access social panel itself
summary: A function on SocialUI, the game's social interface, that, going by its name, hands back that object itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Hide social panel
summary: Going by its name, hides the social panel.
details: Vanilla's files never name it on this type; the Hide lines in the input belong to other texts and are only a hint. It returns nothing.

label: Social button allowed
summary: Whether the Paradox social button may be shown and used.

label: Social panel itself
summary: A function on the social panel that, going by its name, hands back the panel itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Show social panel
summary: Going by its name, shows the social panel.
details: Vanilla's files never name it on this type; the lines with "Show" in the input are ordinary texts and say nothing about it. It returns nothing.

label: Toggle social panel
summary: Opens or closes the Paradox social features from the social button.
details: Vanilla uses it on the social button that shows friends online and unread chats. It returns nothing.

label: Social panel open
summary: Going by its name, whether the Paradox social panel is meant to be open.
details: Vanilla only uses it to light up the Paradox logo on the social button. The game documents nothing more.

label: Access social widget itself
summary: A function on a social widget (a piece of the social interface) that, going by its name, hands back the widget itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Social widget itself
summary: A function on a social widget (a piece of the social interface) that, going by its name, hands back the widget itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access level itself
summary: A function on a spiritual fulfillment level that, going by its name, hands back the level itself.
details: A spiritual fulfillment level is one step on a character's spiritual fulfillment scale; each step has a threshold, modifiers and an icon in common/spiritual_fulfillment. Vanilla never names AccessSelf on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Level icon
summary: The icon of a spiritual fulfillment level.
details: Vanilla shows it on the HUD and in the personal beliefs window, for the level the character has now. Each level sets its icon in common/spiritual_fulfillment with `icon = "gfx/...dds"`. The game documents no return type; vanilla uses it as a texture.

label: Level number
summary: The position of a spiritual fulfillment level on its scale, counted from 0.
details: Vanilla's HUD tooltip adds 1 to it and shows it next to the number of levels, as in "3/7". Levels are numbered in the order they are written in common/spiritual_fulfillment (vanilla's own comments mark them # 0, # 1 …). It returns a whole number.

label: Level name
summary: The display name of a spiritual fulfillment level.
details: Vanilla shows it in the HUD tooltip for the character's personal beliefs and in a shared tooltip. It returns a text.

label: Level effects
summary: A text describing what a spiritual fulfillment level does to the character.
details: Vanilla shows it in the HUD and in a shared tooltip. Each level's effects are its modifiers in common/spiritual_fulfillment (for example more stress gain at low levels); that the text lists exactly these is inferred from the name. It returns a text.

label: Level threshold
summary: The threshold value of a spiritual fulfillment level, shown at the level's marker on the personal beliefs meter.
details: Each level sets `threshold = …` in common/spiritual_fulfillment, and it can be negative (vanilla's lowest Christian level has -95). Vanilla's meter text takes it from the level at each marker (via Character.GetSpiritualFulfillmentLevelByIndex) and shows it without decimals. That it is the spiritual fulfillment value from which a character counts as on that level is inferred from the name and the meter. It returns a number with decimals.

label: Level itself
summary: A function on a spiritual fulfillment level that, going by its name, hands back the level itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access type itself
summary: A function on a spiritual fulfillment type that, going by its name, hands back the type itself.
details: A spiritual fulfillment type is one scale of levels defined in common/spiritual_fulfillment for certain religions (vanilla's christian_fulfillment for Christianity). Vanilla never names AccessSelf on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Levels
summary: The levels of a spiritual fulfillment type, as a list.
details: Vanilla's HUD tooltip counts them to show the total number of levels, as in "3/7". The levels are the `level = { … }` blocks of the type in common/spiritual_fulfillment. The game documents no return type.

label: Type itself
summary: A function on a spiritual fulfillment type that, going by its name, hands back the type itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access queue item itself
summary: A function on an item in the queue of the fullscreen event window that, going by its name, hands back the item itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Item's event
summary: The event that belongs to an item in the queue of the fullscreen event window.
details: The fullscreen event window takes the current item from SplashWindow.GetSplashItem and then uses this to fill the window with that event's content. The game documents no return type.

label: Queue item icon
summary: The icon shown on an item's round button in the queue of the fullscreen event window.
details: Vanilla draws it inside the button as a texture. Where the icon comes from is not documented. The game documents no return type.

label: Queue item name
summary: The name of an item in the queue of the fullscreen event window.
details: Vanilla shows it as the tooltip of the item's button, only while the item is not the selected one. It returns a text.

label: Is resolved
summary: Whether an item in the queue of the fullscreen event window is already done with.
details: Vanilla turns the item's button off once it is resolved, so it can no longer be clicked. That resolved means its event was answered rests on the name. It returns yes or no.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether an item in the queue of the fullscreen event window is the one shown right now.
details: Vanilla draws the selected item's button at full size (the other buttons slightly smaller), gives it an active frame, makes it ignore the mouse and hides its tooltip. It returns yes or no.

label: Click queue item
summary: What happens when the player clicks an item's button in the queue of the fullscreen event window.
details: Vanilla runs it from the item's button. Going by the selected state the window shows, clicking most likely selects the item; the game does not say. It returns nothing.

label: Queue item itself
summary: A function on an item in the queue of the fullscreen event window that, going by its name, hands back the item itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the fullscreen event window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: End transition
summary: Tells the fullscreen event window that its fade-out animation has finished.
details: Vanilla runs it at the end of the window content's fade_out state, which a comment says the game's code starts. What the game does next is not documented. It returns nothing.

label: Queue items
summary: The items in the queue of the fullscreen event window, as a list.
details: Vanilla lists them in a column, each as a round button with its icon. The game documents no return type.

label: Current queue item
summary: The item of the fullscreen event window's queue that the window shows now.
details: Vanilla sets it as the whole window's data and then reads the item's event from it. That it is the current one is inferred from that use. The game documents no return type.

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the fullscreen event window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access tool itself
summary: A function on the engine's spline adjustment tool that, going by its name, hands back the tool itself.
details: The spline adjustment tool belongs to the engine's own built-in tools (internal Clausewitz GUI); going by its name it edits splines (curved lines) using anchor points. Vanilla never names AccessSelf on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Add anchors between
summary: Adds new anchors between the selected anchors in the spline network adjustment tool.
details: Splines are the roads and rivers drawn along the map's navigation mesh; anchors are their points. Vanilla uses it on the button "Add new anchors between selected anchors", shown in anchor selection mode. It returns nothing.

label: Can add anchors
summary: Whether new anchors can be added between the selected anchors in the spline network adjustment tool.
details: Vanilla uses it to switch on the button "Add new anchors between selected anchors".

label: Can delete selection
summary: Whether the selected strips or anchors can be deleted in the spline network adjustment tool.
details: Vanilla uses it to switch on the button "Delete selected strips or anchors".

label: Delete selected
summary: Deletes the selected strips or anchors in the spline network adjustment tool.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Delete selected strips or anchors", shown in anchor selection mode. It returns nothing.

label: Has territory layers
summary: Whether the game has map content layers the spline network adjustment tool can select by.
details: Vanilla shows the "Territory selection mode." button only while this is true. The engine's map content panel says such layers are defined only by some games (e.g. state regions).

label: Has merge notes
summary: Whether the spline network adjustment tool has merge notes to show.
details: Merge notes mark splines after an import: original, conflicting import or new, each in its own colour. Vanilla shows the two merge note buttons only while this is true.

label: Is anchor creation on
summary: Going by its name, whether the spline adjustment tool is in its mode for creating anchor points.
details: An engine tool function (internal Clausewitz GUI) that vanilla's files never name. Going by the names, SelectAnchorCreation switches to this mode. It returns yes or no.

label: Anchor selection mode on
summary: Whether the spline network adjustment tool is in its mode for selecting and changing anchors.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the "Select and modify anchors" button and shows the delete and add anchors buttons only in this mode.

label: Territory selection on
summary: Whether the spline network adjustment tool is in territory selection mode.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the "Territory selection mode." button.

label: Navigation mesh shown
summary: Whether the spline network adjustment tool shows the navigation mesh that splines are placed on.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the navigation mesh button.

label: All merge notes shown
summary: Whether the spline network adjustment tool shows all merge notes.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the button "Show all merge notes".

label: Conflict notes shown
summary: Whether the spline network adjustment tool shows the merge notes about conflicts.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the button "Show all conflict merge notes".

label: Anchor creation mode
summary: Going by its name, switches the spline adjustment tool to its mode for creating anchor points.
details: An engine tool function (internal Clausewitz GUI) that vanilla's files never name. It returns nothing.

label: Anchor selection mode
summary: Switches the spline network adjustment tool to its mode for selecting and changing anchors.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Select and modify anchors". It returns nothing.

label: Territory selection mode
summary: Switches the spline network adjustment tool to territory selection mode.
details: Vanilla uses it on the "Territory selection mode." button, shown only when the game has map content layers. It returns nothing.

label: Tool itself
summary: A function on the engine's spline adjustment tool that, going by its name, hands back the tool itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Toggle conflict notes
summary: Switches showing the merge notes about conflicts in the spline network adjustment tool on or off.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Show all conflict merge notes". It returns nothing.

label: Access mode itself
summary: A function on a mode of the engine's spline adjustment tool that, going by its name, hands back the mode itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Adjustment tool chosen

label: Mode itself
summary: A function on a mode of the engine's spline adjustment tool that, going by its name, hands back the mode itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Strip creation mode
summary: Switches the spline strip tool to its mode for creating a strip between two anchors.
